# Hover text for a cut-off setting NAME or read-only VALUE (not just a description) in the smallest screen the game
# allows: run it with size=640x480 (GUI scale 2 = 320x240). The mouse sits in the middle of the window, so each small
# scroll puts the next row under it: the Spanish Status ("Reproduciendo la canción de p…") on the Music tab and the
# Russian "Название только при смене" on the Display tab should show their whole text in a tooltip.
# Run it: gh workflow run screenshots.yml --ref main -f version=1.21.11 -f mod_ref=<branch> -f size=640x480 -f script=.github/checks/tooltips-small.txt
